posts.body:
EXPIATION
​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
You are Manuel, a young man who can't remember anything about himself, though you the player knows that an old man entity decided to seal Manuel's memory until he finds his way, why? Well this is what you need to find out! But it doesn't end here, the old man gave you his Aura abilities, thanks to this he is able to manifest his emotions in battle, similar to the mythical prophet warrior of ancient times who liberated Mercurius and made it a free land.
Well it was a free land because by the time Manuel finds himself in a valley, the Palladium Empire has already invaded the Kingdom of Mercurius for yet unknown reasons, but maybe it is best you stay away from this and focus on your goal. Various allies will help you alongside the way like Pit the thief and Aurelia the Shikra Witch (Shikra= The local race of the Rubius Archipelago).
Both of these characters join for different reasons but in the end this unlikely trio of friends has some big landscapes to conquer in order to reach Sehrli, a town where the Oracle of Mercurius resides, said to be able to help Manuel regain his lost (sealed?) memory. Bandits, Pirates, the Empire and even demonic beasts stand in their way, are they up to the task?
UNIQUE BATTLE SYSTEM! The game features the ATB battle system but enhanced! Each of the 3 characters plays completely differently. Manuel has the Aura Burst Gauge which fills up as he deals damage but gets also damaged, when full certain Aura skills deal triple damage (similar to FF X's overdrive) and allow for Manuel to decide which of the enemies on the battlefield will skip their next turn! Pit is the fast trickster, responsible for all kinds of utility: Special Items, many ways to regain SP fast, scanning enemies for their weakness and be able to steal all kinds of items from them.  With his unique state; the Weighted Odds state, Pit is able to manipulate and push back the attack bar of enemies, influencing the attack order in battles! Last but not least, Aurelia the cursed Black Mage. She causes her Arcana Curse state either by you the player or uncontrollably in battle every certain amount of turns. Her curse, while making her more vulnerable, enhances her abilities as she is stronger with all the elements and deals more damage with them. Cause a status debuff on a cursed enemy -> the debuff gets transferred on all enemies! Attack a cursed enemy with a spell, watch her attack another enemy as well! And if it is night outside, all her spells are stronger!
If you like what you'll experience in this demo be prepared because the final 2 characters (not in the demo) also have their own unique playstyle to enhance the experience even more!
Different soundeffects used, different BGM chosen to fit for each scene! You can choose between different background window skins. Some sprites touched up with the Gimp software to make sure some scenes are enhanced and better told regardless of the limits of RPG Maker! A day/night cycle that changes your journey on Sinia! Craft recipes and solve Side Quests or try to find the Eldritch Terrors, unique enemies that can randomly spawn in certain areas (2 in this demo)! I promise you, you will enjoy this game!
SCREENSHOTS
Spoiler
SECTION B: CHARACTERS THAT APPEAR IN THE DEMO
Spoiler
Manuel
The protagonist of this story. Age: 19, Height: 168 cm
He suffers from amnesia, being unable to remember
anything about his past. Through mysterious ways, he is
able to manifest his emotions in battle to survive. He is
very kind hearted and eager to help out anyone in need.
His Aura abilities are unique in the game as they allow him
to fight in different ways!
Pit
The cunning thief. Age: 27, Height: 179 cm
He is very cunning and able to rob everyone around him.
Apparently he doesn't have any family anymore but never
talks about his past. People think he is a barbarian but he
actually has a soft side to him. He adores children and
animals and never turns his back on a crying child! Though
he hates the nobles of Sinia.
Aurelia
The black winged witch. Age: 23, Height: 166 cm
She is from the Shikra tribe on the Rubius Archipelago.
Her black wings combined with her devastating magic spells,
made people to give her the nickname black winged witch.
She is very temperamentful and easy to anger. Though a
friend in need. Her curse makes her formidable in battle!
Kellan
The lone swordsman. Age: 38, Height: 186 cm
He is a very skilled swordsman. He grew interested in
Manuels ability so he decided to escort him to Perga.
He mentioned being on a very important mission but kept
the details a secret. He is very honorable and a role model
to many people who look up to him.
Jacob
The calm magician. Age: 40, Height: 175 cm
He is a very skilled magician. He tried to help Manuel
regain his lost memory though was unable to do so.
He seems to be on the same mission as Kellan, though hasn't
spoken about it. He protects Perga for the sake of that
mission as well. The people of Perga love him.
SETTING AND/OR WORLD DEVELOPMENT
Spoiler
Expiation takes place on the world of Sinia, which is divided in 4 lands: The Kingdom of Mercurius, which worships the deity of Aleza. Mercurius was attacked by the Palladium Empire, who is devoted to Priroda, and its citizens aren't allowed to worship Aleza anymore. For unknown reasons they are hunting down Prince Ephraim and anyone affiliated with him. Far to the east of Mercurius lies the Rubius Archipelago, home to the Shikra tribe and Aurelia's homeland. They too worship Aleza. Last but not least is the isolated Nation of Argon, with their own unique language, which you can find letters scattered around to make sure you would be able to communicate with the Argonians. They don't worship either Aleza or Priroda but not much is known about their religion, if there is any at all.

posts.author: isaac3000
posts.body:
I upgraded the demo to V2.1. This is new:
Dynamic battles, actors approach enemies while attacking or there is a zoom in function when an actor or an enemy uses a skill or spell. Idle animations for enemies and most importantly a blinking ATB Bar! Now you can sagfely predict movement turns to strategize even battle your battles!
I made the stealth section much more easier as it works by logic now and it doesn't feel unfair, different monsters are also able to detect you easier depending on the type!
A bug with the cozy aura skill was fixed.
REBALANCED! I played through the whole game without buying all armor and without using any stat boosting items and it was perfectly fine! Now any player can finish the demo regardless of playstyle!
Please feel free to try it out and let me know what you think!

posts.author: isaac3000
posts.body:
Another minor update: Now you can boost your EXP, Money (Eons) and Drop Rates when you kill an enemy if the elelment which it is the most weak against. A "Boosted!" appears in the aftermath screen so you know you did it correctly!
And another minor QoL feature: You can choose to sell items immediately upon getting them, so you won't fill up with things you don't need and have to scroll a huge list with items at vendors to sell.
Please try it out and let me know how it feels

posts.author: Meowsticks
posts.body:
Hey!
I played a bit of this, but I also got invested and watched all of Gamedawg's playthrough so I still have a secondhand knowledge of everything lol.
First I want to say: great job. I can tell that you really care about this game, and you've put a ton of work into it! You definitely "get" it. This has a lot of potential!
Just gonna spew some random thoughts no rhyme or reason:
I like that Manuel, Pit, and Aurelia play differently. I enjoy when characters in RPGs feel different from each other, and you did that! I feel the balancing could be better, but that should always come near the end anyway.
The story is good. The last arc really shines. Everything before that isn't anything special, but it does pick up! I think if you had a stronger hook in the beginning it would be a lot better! Something to give players a look towards what's coming.
The dialogue is still a bit stilted. It's cleaned up a lot, but it still reads awkwardly. Admittedly, I'm an English major so I will always nitpick this stuff LOL. It's
fine,
but could be better. I completely understand that just isn't possible for everyone though.
Thank you for making a turn based RPG with a party. THANK YOU.
Manuel's first aura being a 'hurt yourself to deal big damage' is weird, especially when he's the only one in the party. Players generally don't want to hurt themselves when they are the only ones, leaving them stuck with his admittedly bad standard attack.
Any hints onto the other two party members and how they play
These are all just my thoughts and opinions, take it however you want. This is YOUR game and I want YOU to decide what's best for it. I am invested in this lol and I hope you keep learning, improving, and deliver something great, cause I want to see it through to the end!
Best of luck dude, I'm rooting for ya!
--I FORGOT TO ADD I freaking love the Boss Battle theme lmao never change that it's so good

Oh my this comment totally made my week! Thank you so very much for the encouraging words!
It was very important to me to have them all play differently to have every party member stand out!
Thank you about the story, it is a low burn at first story on purpose as more and more things get revealed gradually but I will consider adding something in the beginning to hook the player faster!
I will try to refine the dialogue some more, as English is my 3rd language I need to be more careful but happy that you enjoyed it!
Another user told me that as well about his aura skill hurting himself but I want for it to stay this way, as he gains more abilities as the game progresses the player has more and more options regarding Manuel and what to have him do in battle.
The other 2 party members are based around their own gauge as well, both of which increase (and decrease this time) differently than Manuel's. Character 4 has a skill that enhances according to the gauge and at 100% gains some unique benefits in battle. Character 5 is based around stance switching as well as QTE input to enhance abilities and skills that are available based on the % of the gauge.
I hope people will enjoy them when the game finally, someday haha, releases!
Thank you so so much again! Also, I have started untold story, I am super excited to find everything! So far I have only explored the first town but I am eager to dive in more! As soon as I get back from my holidays I will continue with it!
Wish you a happy new year soon!

posts.author: isaac3000
posts.body:
UPDATE!
Version 3.0 is online which features the following:
Most importantly the QTE mechanic, similar to games like Expedition 33, you can avoid enemy attacks by timing right your input, but only 1 button is ever used no different ways to dodge in Expiation.
New difficulty modes adjusted to how you want to play with the highest one, merciless, having the smartest enemies which aim for the killing strike, in this mode the QTE is very important to master! But even if you fail the input, the normal HIT/EVA calculations take place so there is always a chance to avoid any attacks naturally (unless they are set to never miss).
Some hidden mechanics in gameplay have been added, like the advantage meter for enemies and the emotion meter for Manuel the protagonist. Based on how each battle evolves enemies or manuel become better in combat (or worse), no battle formation shall ever play out the same.
Field abilities are now in the game! You can use elemental spells like fire, ice etc. to interact with certain environments (freeze the water, make plants grow etc.)
Feel free to try it out and let me know what you think. I hope you will enjoy this demo (and maybe replay on higher difficulties even) with hopefully being eager to try out the full game, which is steadily evolving!
Thanks in advance!

posts.author: isaac3000
posts.body:
Thanks to a user, I changed the QTE from a reaction to a prediction system, here is a pic of how it looks in battle:
To prevent muscle memory, the area you need to hit switches around so you need to be alerted!
These are very important to succeed the best you can on merciless mode!
Speaking of merciless, Yu_Starwing managed to beat the game on merciless blind! Which means all systems are working! Of course it was difficult during the end section but he was victorious!
Merciless is supposed to be taken on after you know the game, not blind, but he is proof it IS possible!
Please try it out and let me know what your experience was. Give the game a try, don't be scared away by the RTP graphics!
